approved_facts: Italus is a mature Bosnian pine tree (Pinus heldreichii), with trunk, bark, roots, cambium and resin.
Italus participates as the tree in the 589 Pollino lightning event.
Luca is a fourteen-year-old human shepherd boy in the 789 mainline.
In 789 Luca observes fresh disturbed ground and displaced roots suggesting Italus has moved.
In the 789 mainline a reclusive human monk observes Luca and later offers prayer as a credible cover for his visits.
The human figure in the 589 storm has human palms and sustains lightning-related palm injury.
The current chapter's 589 storm and 789 discovery take place in the Pollino landscape of southern Italy.
The 589 storm is a brief external historical flashback shown before the 789 mainline.
During the 589 storm an unidentified human figure is in direct physical contact with mature Italus, the pine tree, when lightning strikes.
The human figure sustains scorched palm injuries; Italus sustains resin and cambium damage.
Depict the immediate sensory aftermath and transition back to 789 before explaining any longer-term effect.
After the 589 external flashback, show Luca in 789 discovering fresh physical evidence that Italus has moved.
The monk later offers Luca prayer as a credible cover story.
